Class Quote

java.lang.Object
com.leap.leaplaughlove.marketdata.ingestion.Quote
@Entity public class Quote extends Object
Represents a single quote accepted by the ingestion pipeline for an instrument. Contains bid/ask/last price and size, the exchange it was quoted on, the feed's sequence number, and both the feed's own timestamp and this backend's ingestion time.
